adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and passes them directly into `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no validation or bounds. This allows arbitrarily large `limit` values (potentially dumping/DoS via huge responses) and negative `offset` (e.g., `offset = -1`) which will generate SQL with a negative OFFSET and can raise a Postgres error (500). The finding matches the code introduced in this diff.
